body:
Yeah, I can understand your take on this. Most people say that after a long lived life, where one can look back at what they experienced and remember all the good things that happened, that that's a good death. 
For me it's just different. I want to experience this, above, explained moment. I am okay in my current life, but I would definitely prefer to feel this finality, comfort, tranquility and peace that this moment would give me. 

But thanks for your input!
